observations: Photo 0 shows a used automotive transmission/gearbox, dirty and oily, with a starter motor and hoses attached, and a blue paint mark on the casing.
Photo 1 shows the side of the same unit with electrical connectors, multi-colored wires, linkages, and sensor ports.
Photo 2 shows the bell housing side with a circular bolt pattern and no visible identification plate.
No brand, model, or part number is readable in any of the three photos.
The seller's text describes a general dealer business and makes no specific condition claim about this unit.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical condition (gears, clutches, bearings) cannot be seen externally.
risks.proof: Video of bench test or input shaft rotation and gear selection.

risks.risk: Fluid leaks from seals, pan, or casing cracks.
risks.proof: Underside photos or leak test with fluid.

risks.risk: Electrical sensors or solenoids (if automatic) may be non-functional.
Bell housing or mounting ears may be cracked or damaged.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of bell housing and mounting points.

proof_requests: Clear photo of any identification plate or stamping on the transmission case.
Video showing input shaft rotation and gear selection if possible.
Underside photos showing the pan and seals for leaks.
Close-up of the bell housing and mounting ears.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used car gearbox from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case (non-working) pending verification.
